::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 2d 1900  
**From:** Elderfield  Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

Dear [Madam](people/person_176.qmd)
I am much perplexed about the article ‘Want of Confidence’ - I had <u>two</u> so called sent to me, purporting to be condensations of a lecture given at Winchester, one certainly written by [Mrs Field](people/person_507.qmd). When it appeare[d] a gentleman wrote and claimed it as his own abstract but Mrs Field was able to prove it was hers, and as yours had the same title I am afraid the copy in type must have been broken up under the impression that it was the duplicate account of the lecture for I cannot find it either in proof or M S and it is the only way I can account for its disappearance.[^1]

I am very sorry not to be able to restore it

If you can tell me how many pages it occupied I will send you some small compensation,

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to 'Mrs Bothamly/ The Crossways/ Bromley'.
[^2]: The contribution was evidently to [*Mothers in Council*](organizations/other_82.qmd).
